name: Neck Release

frames.label: Start
frames.cue: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze forward.

frames.label: Right Tilt
frames.cue: Slowly bring your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting the shoulder.

frames.label: Right Hold
frames.cue: Hold only within a comfortable range; keep both shoulders heavy.

frames.label: Center Reset
frames.cue: Return your head slowly to center.

frames.label: Left Tilt
frames.cue: Slowly bring your left ear toward your left shoulder without lifting the shoulder.

frames.label: Left Hold
frames.cue: Hold gently, then prepare to return to neutral when the timer ends.

safety: Keep the movement small, slow and pain-free.
Do not pull the head with either hand or force the stretch.
Stop for dizziness, tingling, numbness, sharp pain or pain traveling into an arm.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Neck Release feel? Note any side-to-side difference, stiffness, pain, dizziness, tingling or limited range.
